groups.reason: No running consumer mounts this unused generated volume; installation verification exists but current content not independently reread.

caveats: Only generated config/secret volumes were byte-compared with synthetic inputs. Datastore volumes contain mutable state and were not dumped or exhaustively scanned while the verifier ran.
Volume metadata and generated-input provenance support synthetic origin; arbitrary secrets inside every datastore page cannot be ruled out by this check.
Only the last 300 log entries per container at capture time were inspected. Earlier, rotated, later and application-file logs are unexamined.

Any exposure of generated arena credentials is disclosed separately; synthetic origin does not imply ideal log hygiene. Endpoint string matches are evidence of text, not proof of a network connection.
